transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because... well, my wife wanted me to come in. I guess I've been doing a lot lately. Just, you know, starting things. Work plans, studying for certifications, redoing the home network. I reached out to a bunch of old contacts. It just... it gets a bit intense, I suppose. I don't really stop until my wife or my director at work tells me I need to.
During these times when you're taking on so much, how much sleep do you find yourself needing?

Not much, I guess. Um... there have been runs where I sleep maybe three hours. I'll just wake up sharp at 3 or 4 a.m. I don't feel tired, though. It just feels like... like I've been handed bonus time to get things done.
Have you ever had periods in your life when you felt the opposite—down, depressed, or losing interest in things?

Yeah... I suppose so. There are stretches where I... I don't know, I just wake up feeling heavy. Flat. Like a failed version of myself, I guess. I don't really want to do much during those times. Even just... answering my wife's normal questions feels like too much. So I just kind of keep to myself.
During these high-energy periods, have they ever caused serious problems or major disruptions in your life, such as at work or in your relationships?

...Yeah. I guess you could say that. 

At work... there was a network migration project I was running. It, um... it failed. They ended up putting me on leave after that. So that wasn't great. 

And at home... my wife has had to step in a lot. Just managing the spending, or trying to stop the late-night work. A lot of our conversations lately just... turn into arguments. 

I don't know. I've also just kind of pulled away from other things. I used to do church music, rock climbing... mentoring some of the junior guys. But I stopped. It's just... I can't really reliably show up or follow through on any of it right now.
During these high-energy periods, have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?

...Um. I guess. It's kind of hard to explain. 

When I was... really driven, hardly sleeping and trying to push all those big plans through... sometimes I'd be in the server room, and the background noise... it sounded like there were comments in it. Like words just under the hum of the machines. 

And... I don't know. I was also reading into work messages a lot. Seeing hidden threats in them. But... yeah. I guess that's it.
